caption:
Short curtains make your whole bedroom look smaller.

Most curtain panels are cut for an average window, so on a taller window they stop short of the floor and leave a gap at the top where light sneaks in. That gap is also why a room never feels fully dark, even with the lights off and the shades down.

These NICETOWN panels run 84 inches long with a grommet top, so they hang higher on the rod and drop closer to the floor, covering more of the window. Close to sixty thousand people have rated them 4.7 stars.

For about $16 for the two-panel set, the room reads bigger, darker, and more finished without replacing the window or the rod.
